Subject: MAP: throughput benchmark & unit-econ readout for LuminaPay

Hi Samantha —

Per our call this morning, attached is the proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the performance evaluation LuminaPay requested. High-level goals: validate sustained QPS for your tokenization pipeline, confirm TTFT and p95 latency at target concurrency, and produce a unit-economics sheet we can sign off on before procurement.

Snapshot of what the plan covers (attached PDF):
- Test matrix: concurrency sweep (4, 8, 16, 32 workers), payloads (avg 120 tokens, 512 tokens tail), and warm/cold KV cache runs.
- Key metrics captured: tokens/sec, sustained QPS, TTFT (time to first token), p50/p95/p99 latency for generation and decode, GPU utilization, and per-1M-token cost estimate across quantization variants.
- Acceptance criteria: sustained QPS >= 250 (for 120-token avg) with p95 <= 220ms; TTFT <= 40ms for cached prefixes.
- Timeline and owners: test run by 9/13, readout + unit-econ by 9/14, legal/procurement kickoff 9/16.

Attachments: lumina-map-benchmark-plan-v1.pdf

Next steps: Can you confirm 9/13 for test window (08:00–12:00 PT)? Also confirm a single sandbox API key and representative payload set (we'll need 10k sample real requests).

Thanks — eager to get you reliable numbers you can use in the procurement deck.

Best,
Avery Johnson

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-09-12 09:05 PDT
Subject: INTERNAL: perf test config + quick notes before tomorrow

Team —

Quick notes ahead of the 9/13 run (I'll own execution):
- Environment: Dedicated test pool on g5.4xlarge (8xA100 equiv). We will run both 8-bit quant (GPTQ) and FP16 baseline.
- Workload: 10k requests, 80% short (avg 120 tokens), 20% long (avg 512 tokens). We will run three phases: cold start, warmed KV cache, and sustained 30-minute soak at target concurrency.
- Measurement tooling: token/sec measured by combined server-side counters; sustained QPS computed with 1-minute rolling window; TTFT measured at server transmit of first chunk. We'll log GPU mem and utilization every 10s.
- Pass/fail: For MAP readout we present both raw numbers and an econ summary: cost per 1M tokens (in hosted vs dedicated), estimated infra cost per peak hour, and projected monthly run-rate at expected 300M tokens/month.

Preliminary target values to hit for confident signoff:
- tokens/sec (short payloads) sustained at >= 48k tokens/sec across the pool (equivalent to 250 QPS at 120 tokens).
- TTFT <= 40ms when cache hit, p95 latency <= 240ms.
- At 8-bit quant, expect ~20–25% lower infra cost; measure any quality delta with the Lumina failure set (we have a small eval harness).

I'll upload throughput-readout-20260913.csv and unit-econ-summary-09014.xlsx after the run.

-rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Performance Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@luminapay.com>, Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@luminapay.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-13 17:38 PDT
Subject: Readout: throughput run results + unit-econ summary (see attachments)

Samantha / Carlos —

Thanks for the window this morning. Attached are the raw run CSV and a one-page econ summary. Highlights first, then a short recommendation for the MAP close path.

Highlights (sustained warm cache run, 30m soak, mixed payloads):
- Sustained tokens/sec (mix): 52,400 tokens/sec across the pool -> sustained QPS (avg 1-min) = 437 at weighted avg token size (actual Lumina mix).
- Short-payload sustained QPS (120 tokens avg): 435 QPS (meets and exceeds target).
- TTFT median = 18ms (cache hit), p95 TTFT = 32ms.
- Response generation latencies (p50/p95/p99): 85ms / 190ms / 420ms (long tails on some >1k-token cases).
- GPU utilization: avg 68%, spikes to 94% during long request bursts. No OOMs observed.

Unit economics (summary):
- Hosted API baseline (our public offering): estimated $0.68 per 1k tokens -> $680 per 1M tokens.
- Dedicated pool (after reserved commit, 6mo): infra + infra-ops blended -> ~$120 per 1M tokens (FP16), ~$95 per 1M tokens (8-bit quant) for this workload.
- Recommendation: LuminaPay can hit target SLA at ~435 sustained QPS with a 3-node dedicated pool (g5.4x equiv) + 8-bit quantization for most traffic. Expected monthly cost at 300M tokens/month: ~$28.5k (8-bit) vs ~$36k (FP16). These numbers exclude networking and egress; included in the full XLS.

Risk notes:
- Long-tail >1k token sessions created p99 spikes; we recommend a token cap/streaming fallback for sessions likely to exceed 1k tokens.
- Quantization quality: in small eval set we saw negligible delta for completion quality for the 8-bit variant, but we recommend a small A/B rollout for one week.

Suggested MAP close steps:
- 9/14: shared readout and signoff on econ numbers (this is the formal acceptance of the performance KPIs).
- 9/16: procurement + legal kickoff (contract & reserved capacity options).
- 9/23: planned canary rollout (10% traffic) and monitoring dashboard link share.

Attachments: throughput-readout-20260913.csv, unit-econ-summary-09014.xlsx

If this looks good I'll update the MAP with the readout numbers and send a short signoff doc for LuminaPay procurement to countersign.

Thanks everyone — great run from the infra team.

Best,
Avery
